data.input: Create a script named 'dual_rw.sh' that simulates dual read/write by appending a timestamped line to a file named 'dual_rw.log' each time it is run.

rawInput.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dual_rw.sh — simulates dual read/write by appending a timestamped
# line to dual_rw.log each time it is run.

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
LOG_FILE="${SCRIPT_DIR}/dual_rw.log"

TIMESTAMP="$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')"
HOSTNAME_INFO="$(hostname)"
PID_INFO="$$"

echo "${TIMESTAMP} dual_rw event pid=${PID_INFO} host=${HOSTNAME_INFO}" >> "${LOG_FILE}"

echo "Appended to ${LOG_FILE}: ${TIMESTAMP} dual_rw event pid=${PID_INFO} host=${HOSTNAME_INFO}"
